items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: see, I recorded with Toots Tillman in Paris

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, they‘ll send you all these papers. I‘ve got papers and papers, you know. Well, if you tried to understand and to read all that crap, you‘d be crazy, you know. So I just say, okay. Carmen told me something years ago, because we were hanging out in Holland, and I had just signed with them. She said . . . I‘d like to make some money. Not that being famous is that important, but you‘ve got to have a certain amount of fame in order to make the money. She said, ―One thing I can tell you, baby, is get the…
Have you had a similar experience with management? What has your experience been with management? You mentioned John Levy. I know that Joel Seigel worked with you.
